_comment: The teaching-corpus manifest — ADR-0043 scope A as amended at It-2/It-3 (reviewable curation, never vibes). Ordered include globs; first match wins; exclusions are explicit so every absence is legible. LICENSE and NOTICE ride in-bundle (Apache-2.0 §4: redistributions carry the License and any NOTICE; the output-grant's waiver does not cover redistributing the template itself — missing-glob tolerance covers pre-Apache tags, whose bundles are immutable anyway). CHANGELOG and TEMPLATE-UPDATES are pointers-not-cargo (history, one URL away). Missing globs are tolerated (e.g. placeholders.yaml predates nothing before v3.12).
